_why: Until 1.4.0 this addon had no Control Panel surface at all, and three UI rules were disabled
on that ground. Two of them are now simply satisfied: there is a CP bundle, built by Vite from
resources/js, registered through the provider's $vite property, with @statamic/cms in
devDependencies so the UI kit is pinned to the Statamic in vendor/. Those two entries are gone.
ui.no-dom-piercing stays disabled. It flags document.body.appendChild in rich.js, and that rule
protects a Vue component tree in the CP. The element in question is the toolbar that appears over
a text selection on a client's own page, and it has to be a direct child of body and
position: fixed: anywhere else, the first ancestor with overflow: hidden clips it, and on a real
client site that ancestor exists. The CP bundle does not pierce anything.
release.editions is an INFO, not a rule, and it asks a question rather than reporting a fault:
"Confirm this is a single-edition commercial addon." Confirmed on 2026-09-19 — one product,
no free/pro split, $49 on the Statamic Marketplace (MARKETPLACE.md has the reasoning). A free
tier was considered and rejected: the only natural cut is plain text free and everything else
paid, and plain text alone does not do the job anybody installs this for. The field stays
absent because the linter is right that a declared edition without a feature behind it cannot
